description: Firefly synchronous flash — 10k agents, Kuramoto phase-coupled oscillators, traveling light waves, slow hover with attractor convergence.
notes: Photinus carolinus (Great Smoky Mountains) is one of very few firefly species that achieve synchrony. The Kuramoto model with coupling constant K≈0.8 and natural frequency 1 Hz reproduces observed sync onset at ~50 individuals within interaction radius. Flash visible 20ms around phase=0.
